capabilities._note: A caption (style, mood, vocals, arrangement) and lyrics whose section tags are its structure; no bpm, key or meter input, so the tempo is in the words. Measured on local ComfyUI 2026-11-03/04 (docs/SOUND.md 'Measured: MiniMax Music 3, HeartMuLa and Magenta RealTime 2'): **a song model**. Its words came through best of three (a word error rate of 0.06-0.08 against YuE2's 0.08-0.32), but it doesn't hold a tempo (96 asked: 83-115) and its length is a cap (the take may end sooner). As score it leaks a voice: empty lyrics ended takes at a median 32 s of 52 with a vocal stem 2-13 dB under the mix; section tags alone reached the length and leaked less, and the arc wasn't followed (climax in place 1 of 8). So it is offered for songs, score only by choice. MiniMax's community licence: free for commercial use under $20M yearly revenue, the outputs the user's.

template._note: The take's longest; MiniMaxMusic3TextEncode's max_duration (the model can end sooner).

binding._note: ComfyUI's audio_minimax_music_3 template, flattened: UNETLoader (the DiT), CLIPLoader type minimax (the text encoder, which also writes the take's codes and so decides its length), VAELoader (the DAV), MiniMaxMusic3TextEncode (caption, lyrics, seed, max_duration, cfg_scale 1.7, top_k 50) with its conditioning zeroed for the negative, EmptyMiniMaxMusic3LatentAudio from the encoder's seconds, KSampler 30 steps euler simple cfg 1.7, VAEDecodeAudioTiled (1536 / 64: the template's own choice behind its switch; a long song decoded whole took ComfyUI down on 2026-11-04), SaveAudio. The seed goes to the encoder and the sampler.

final._note: The template's files and settings (30 steps, cfg 1.7).

proxy._note: The int8 DiT (the template's low-VRAM choice); most of a take's time is the encoder writing its codes, which steps don't change.

downloads._note: The files ComfyUI's audio_minimax_music_3 template names (its Model Links note), from Comfy-Org/MiniMax-Music-3.
